node.statement: Scoped dependency bridge for node 1.4.1: assume exactly the explicitly declared dependencies 1.1 and 1.3. Dependency 1.1 supplies t_j>=0 for every j and t_j>=H-a*tau for every j notin G_a; dependency 1.3 supplies sum_j P_vj^+*t_j<=nu_v*(2+4*delta). Since P_vj^+=max(P_vj,0)>=0, summing the lower bound over j notin G_a gives (H-a*tau)*sum_{j notin G_a} P_vj^+ <= sum_{j notin G_a} P_vj^+*t_j. Because t_j>=0 and P_vj^+>=0, the restricted sum is at most sum_j P_vj^+*t_j. Applying 1.3 gives (H-a*tau)*sum_{j notin G_a} P_vj^+ <= nu_v*(2+4*delta). Finally H>a*tau makes H-a*tau>0, so division by H-a*tau yields sum_{j notin G_a} P_vj^+ <= nu_v*(2+4*delta)/(H-a*tau).
